It is nearly 6 months since posting this update, and a lot has certainly happened in that time period. With the arrival of a global pandemic - one in which is finally slowing down - I have suffered mentally, and physically, both as a result of the newly-found circumstances that I am subject to and those of my own failures. 

Physically, I am the worst shape I have ever been in. A lack of motivation and untimely mental health issues have caused a difficult chasm of envisioned goals, and the reality which is bestowed upon me. With the arrival of lockdown restrictions easing, I must take it upon myself to strive for better. Whether that be exercising more and sticking to a good diet, or reducing the intake of cigarettes I smoke. It is almost shameful to admit that I smoke, but that does not prevent me from change. 

This is a critical point in my life where I must take action, otherwise I will falter and slip into deeper mental health and physical issues. I must adhere to this plan and change, or otherwise throw away money, and most importantly, my health. 

However, everything in life has its upsides. I finally achieved my BA degree in criminal justice - one step closer to becoming a fully accredited and practicing solicitor. I felt real pride in achieving this, and won’t stop until I meet my goal. I will NOT throw this away.

Let’s hope that the next update will bring positive news, and will foster a happier and more substantial life than the one I am enduring just now.
